title: The Inherited IRA 10-Year Bomb Costing Heirs $85K
hook: Your parent left you their IRA as a final gift — but a 2020 law quietly turned that inheritance into a tax bomb most families never see coming.
angle: The SECURE Act eliminated the 'stretch IRA' in 2020, forcing every non-spouse heir to drain the account in 10 years instead of a lifetime — a change that creates massive taxable income spikes most heirs and advisors never plan for
audience: Anyone who has or expects to inherit an IRA, parents with IRAs doing estate planning, and workers contributing to retirement accounts
key_numbers: 10-year forced distribution window (was stretch over lifetime before 2020)
Up to $85,000 in extra taxes vs. old stretch-IRA strategy
30 million IRA accounts in the US holding $13.5 trillion
Year-10 dump into highest bracket can cost 37 cents on every dollar
